arabic text: KYA KARUN YE TO BATA BHAI NAHI SAR PE RIDA\nSAR PE BABA BHI NAHI KAUN SUNE MERI SADA\nHUKM ZAALIM KA HAI DARBAR MEIN AAYE ZAINAB
english translation text: WHAT SHOULD I DO, O BROTHER, WHEN I HAVE NO HEAD COVERING?\nI ALSO DO NOT HAVE MY FATHER (ALI AS), WHO CAN HEAR MY LAMENTATION\nTHE OPPRESSOR HAS ORDERED ZAINAB TO ENTER THE PALACE

arabic text: MERA BABA HAI ALI AUR MERA NANA NABI\nDARD O GHAM SEH KE BHI MAI DEEN BACHA KAR HOON CHALI\nSHAAM MEIN GOONJ RAHI THI YE SADA E ZAINAB
english translation text: MY FATHER IS ALI AS AND MY GRANDFATHER IS THE HOLY PROPHET SAW\nWITH PAIN AND GRIEF, I AM STILL GOING TO SAVE THE RELIGION\nTHIS CRY OF ZAINAB WAS ECHOING THROUGHOUT SHAAM

arabic text: BAAD SHABBIR KE SAAYE MEIN NAHI AAYI RABAB\nGHAMZADA BEHEN KO IS BAAT KA DE BHAI JAWAB\nDHOOP SE USKO BATA KAISE UTHAYE ZAINAB
english translation text: AFTER SHABBIR AS, RUBAB DID NOT SIT UNDER A SHADE\nCAN SOMEONE GIVE AN ANSWER TO THIS PAIN-STRICKEN SISTER?\nHOW SHOULD ZAINAB REMOVE HER FROM THE SCORCHING SUN?

arabic text: SHAAM MANZIL HAI MERI BHAI HAI BE-GOR O KAFAN\nNA HI MATAM HAI KIYA NA HI KIYA USKO DAFAN\nBAAT YE TU HI BATA KAISE BHULAYE ZAINAB
english translation text: MY DESTINATION IS DAMASCUS AND MY BROTHER LAYS WITHOUT A SHROUD\nI HAVEN’T BEEN ABLE TO LAMENT OVER HIM, NOR HAVE I BEEN ABLE TO BURY HIM\nTELL ME HOW SHOULD ZAINAB FORGET THESE TRAGEDIES?

arabic text: KYA HAI AASAAN YE KHURSHEED BHALA NAUHAGARI\nJAANTE HAI YE SUKHANWAR KE YE MANZIL HAI KADI\nBAAT BANTI HAI JO HOJAYE ATA E ZAINAB
english translation text: O KHURSHEED (POET), WHO SAYS WRITING NAWHAS IS EASY?\nALL THE AZADAAR KNOW THAT THIS IS A CHALLENGING TASK\nMAY ZAINAB ACCEPT THIS NOBLE ACT
